summary: Nine games were played. Anthony Edwards scored 47 for Minnesota, but Cleveland won 127-125 in overtime. Boston beat Chicago 134-99 and led by as many as 40, and Brandon Miller scored 39 in Charlotte's 110-103 win over Washington. Golden State beat Denver 134-114.

games.headline: Miller scores 39 as Hornets beat Wizards 110-103
games.story: Charlotte outscored Washington 35-23 in the second quarter and led 54-44 at halftime, going ahead for good at 27-26 with 8:47 left in the half. The Hornets' lead reached 14 with one minute left in the third quarter, and the Wizards outscored them 35-30 in the fourth but never got closer than three points. Brandon Miller scored 39 on 15-of-28 shooting with five three-pointers, and Moussa Diabaté had 11 points and 17 rebounds. Anthony Davis scored 29 for Washington and Trae Young had 22 points and 10 assists.

games.headline: Cavaliers beat Wolves 127-125 in OT despite Edwards' 47
games.story: Minnesota led 60-50 at halftime and by as many as 15 in the second quarter, but Cleveland outscored the Timberwolves 36-26 in the third. The game was tied at 113 with 10 seconds left in regulation and again at 121 with 1:03 left in overtime. The Cavaliers went ahead for good at 123-121 with 48 seconds left and led 127-122 with three seconds to play. Anthony Edwards scored 47 for Minnesota on 19-of-34 shooting, while Donovan Mitchell scored 26 for Cleveland and James Harden had 19 points and 9 assists.

games.headline: Pritchard scores 28 as Celtics rout Bulls 134-99
games.story: Boston led 33-21 after the first quarter and 66-54 at halftime, then outscored Chicago 39-21 in the third. The Celtics' lead reached 40 with 4:28 left in the fourth, and the Bulls never led. Payton Pritchard scored 28 in under 22 minutes, making seven of 10 three-pointers, and Jayson Tatum had 23 points, 7 rebounds and 6 assists. Norman Powell led Chicago with 20 points and Caleb Wilson had 17.

games.headline: Flagg scores 29 as Mavericks beat Heat 113-109
games.story: Miami led by as many as 12 in the second quarter, but Dallas went into halftime ahead 53-52. The game was tied at 95 with 6:57 left, and the Mavericks went ahead for good at 97-96 with 6:12 to play. Cooper Flagg scored 29 with 11 assists, 5 steals and 3 blocks, and P.J. Washington added 20 points. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 29 points, 14 rebounds and 11 assists for Miami.

games.headline: Bucks rally past Pacers 110-102 behind Herro's 23
games.story: Indiana led 61-50 at halftime and by as many as 11 in the second quarter. Milwaukee outscored the Pacers 34-24 in the third and 26-17 in the fourth, going ahead for good at 88-86 with 10:08 left. Tyler Herro scored 23 with 10 rebounds and 7 assists, and Kel'el Ware had 16 points and 14 rebounds in 19 minutes. Tyrese Haliburton scored 22 with 9 assists for Indiana, and Pascal Siakam had 20 points and 13 rebounds.

games.headline: Mitchell scores 30 as Thunder beat Suns 125-114
games.story: Oklahoma City led 33-27 after the first quarter and 67-53 at halftime, going ahead for good at 26-24 in the first. The Thunder's lead reached 22 with 6:08 left in the fourth. Ajay Mitchell scored 30 on 10-of-16 shooting, including nine of 10 from the free throw line, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 26 points in 30 minutes. Jalen Green scored 20 for Phoenix and Dillon Brooks had 19.

games.headline: Sengun scores 29 as Rockets beat Hawks 120-110
games.story: Atlanta led 35-32 after the first quarter and 66-63 at halftime. Houston outscored the Hawks 28-19 in the third quarter and went ahead for good at 77-76 with 6:06 left in the period. The Rockets' lead reached 22 with 4:44 to play. Alperen Sengun scored 29 with 9 rebounds, 9 assists and 6 steals, and Kevin Durant had 22 points. Jalen Johnson scored 21 for Atlanta and CJ McCollum had 20.

games.headline: Grizzlies hold off Jazz rally to win 110-105
games.story: Memphis led 30-21 after the first quarter and by as many as 16 in the third. Utah outscored the Grizzlies 29-21 in the fourth and cut the lead to 106-105 with 1:01 left, but did not score again, and Memphis closed the game on a 4-0 run. Keyonte George led Utah with 26 points and 6 assists. Cedric Coward had 16 points and 11 rebounds for Memphis, making all four of his three-point attempts.

games.headline: Warriors beat Nuggets 134-114 as Lendeborg scores 31
games.story: Golden State went ahead for good at 55-52 with 2:34 left in the second quarter and led 60-56 at halftime. The Warriors outscored Denver 40-28 in the third and led by 24 with 2:32 left in the fourth. Yaxel Lendeborg scored 31 with 12 rebounds and 6 assists, and Stephen Curry had 24 points on 8-of-8 shooting. Nikola Jokić had 19 points and 11 assists for Denver, and DeMar DeRozan scored 21.
